verdict.rationale: Formant's docs describe installing an agent on ROS 2 devices, ingesting telemetry streams, and giving 'instant visibility into every robot' with live status, an Observe view, realtime visualizations via the RealtimeSDK, and time-synced sensor records, which covers remote inspection of live robot state. Missing for 10: explicit evidence of remote log viewing, explicit documentation of browsing live ROS topics (only implied by the ROS 2 agent and telemetry ingestion), and independent or hands-on corroboration of the remote debugging workflow.
